persons.name: Bhaṭṭa
persons.evidence: bhaṭṭasyedaṃ pustakam iti || ... alekhi vai parahitaṃ svārthaṃ ca bhaṭṭena

purpose: parahitaṃ svārthaṃ ca (for the benefit of others and oneself), sadbhaktārtham
notes: The scribe and owner is identified as Bhaṭṭa. The final corrupt phrase 'sadvidyāyurgguṇino gadaṃtu viduṣā cintākhyakanādarān(?)' might contain an epithet or name (Cintākhya?), but due to extreme uncertainty it is not extracted as a separate individual.
